content:
**Abandoned Mine Shaft 2** is a location in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia. 

The second in a series of abandoned mine shafts, this one was undergoing repair on the cover when the Great War happened. Years later, radiation continues to leak from the cover.

Launching a nuke towards this location will awaken the Ultracite Titan and starts the Event: Seismic Activity at the Nuka-Launcher. In addition, part of the unmarked quest What Slept Beneath takes place here.

Entering from the west, the player character will first encounter a blue shack cluttered with containers and some loot. Proceeding through a door to the east and up a staircase leads to a second blue shack. This one has more containers, including two searchable chem containers, and additional loot. A southern door leads to the top of a refinery adjacent to both pods.

The location was overhauled with the *Nuka-World on Tour* update. Many Ultracite crystals now dot the surrounding area, with additional clutter being added. The corpse of Jack Woodhouse is leaning on the outer wall of the lower shack.

Abandoned Mine Shaft 2 appears in *Fallout 76*.
